gloss: to take back; to recapture; to win back

definitions.gloss: to take back; to recapture; to win back
definitions.explanation: To take back by force or effort something that was taken from you: a possession, a castle, territory, a title or the lead in a game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{王座|おうざ}→王座：21328_ouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}す。
⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: He immediately won back the ball he'd lost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{奪|うば}われた→奪う：01895_ubau⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}す⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The general gathered troops to recapture the castle the enemy had taken.

notes:
⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧ (to take by force) + ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (back). Common in sports reporting (⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}す, to retake first place) as well as in history and fiction.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: what is retaken takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧; the person it is taken from takes から.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}す: to retake first place
- ⟦{王座|おうざ}→王座：21328_ouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}す: to regain the championship
- ⟦{領土|りょうど}→領土：15711_ryoudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}す: to recapture territory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{返|かえ}す→取り返す：06050_torikaesu⟧: to get back, to recover; broader and less forceful
- ⟦{奪還|だっかん}→奪還：15608_dakkan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recapture; the formal Sino-Japanese equivalent
